profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Nasdaq
profile.summary: Over fifteen years of experience implementing custom software solutions across a variety of industries.  Designed and implemented custom manufacturing operations solutions, based on Lean principles,  to enable maximum throughput and efficiency.  Developed B2B integrations to both drive sales and generate actionable business intelligence data.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Vue.js · .NET · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Elasticsearch · Microsoft SQL Server · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Migrated suite of corporate benefit management applications from on-site to cloud deployment.
Designed and implemented bespoke order management system for a commercial printing company.
Improved performance of custom manufacturing software.
Utilized expertise to provide valuable software audits and technology evaluations to clients
Automated UI testing of photo-editing web application.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · .NET · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer, Owner
positions.description:
Implemented a human-based image moderation application.

Developed and tested B2B integration software to drive inventory sales at third party vendors.

Streamlined pre-shipment sorting of manufacturing finished products and provided effective reporting with custom software tools and processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with accounting to create a system to manage royalty and commission calculations and payments.

Developed APIs for managing user-generated website content.

positions.title: Owner, Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed custom software for clients a variety of industries including education and photo commerce.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Worked with business partners and internal stakeholders to design and implement B2B integrations.

Improved manufacturing efficiency with custom operations software.

Managed software integrations with commercial photo printing equipment.
